one_line: Sultan Mahmud Begada of Gujarat and Rajput ruler Patai Rawal face off during the long siege of Pavagadh (1482–1484 CE).

appearance.age_look: Mahmud looks late 20s with a sturdy, athletic build; Patai looks mid 30s with a lean, battle-hardened frame.
appearance.face: Mahmud has a broad oval face, wheatish complexion, neatly trimmed black beard, sharp nose, and intense, calculating eyes with a calm, commanding default expression; Patai has a narrower face, sun-browned complexion, straight prominent nose, strong jaw with well-groomed moustache and short beard, and a proud, defiant default expression.
appearance.hair: Mahmud’s hair is black, mostly hidden under a tall dark-green conical turban wrapped with a cream band and a small central emerald-like jewel; Patai’s black hair is shoulder-length, slightly wavy, parted center, held back by a saffron-orange cloth headband with a small central metal disc.
appearance.costume: Mahmud wears a long, dark-green quilted jama-style coat reaching mid-calf, tied diagonally to the right with a cream sash at the waist, subtle diamond quilting pattern suggesting padded armour, over a cream-coloured under-tunic and loose cream churidar trousers; he has a knee-length sleeveless mail vest hinted under the coat opening, dark-brown leather belt with a simple metal buckle, and soft dark-brown leather boots that rise mid-calf; over his shoulders is a light cream woollen shawl with a thin dark-green border, draped neatly, and he wears modest gold hoop earrings and a simple ring on the right hand; Patai wears a knee-length, off-white cotton angarkha with a wrap to the left, faint red border at the edges, girded tightly with a deep-red cloth kamarband, over reddish-brown fitted trousers; over the angarkha he has a sleeveless, rust-red cotton-silk battlevest with minimal decoration and a short mail shirt visible at the armholes; he wears simple brown leather sandals with straps and has a narrow iron armguard on his left forearm; his jewellery is restrained—a thin gold chain, small stud earrings, and a red cotton tilak mark on his forehead.
appearance.signature: Mahmud carries a slightly curved, sheathed Indo-Persian talwar with a dark-brown leather scabbard, simple steel crossguard and disc pommel hanging from his belt; Patai carries a Rajput-style steel talwar with a gently flaring tip, brass hilt with knuckle-guard, and a red-brown leather scabbard worn at his left hip.

ref_desc: Mahmud Begada is a wheatish, broad-faced young sultan with a dark-green conical turban, quilted dark-green jama over cream garments, leather boots and a sheathed talwar, facing Patai Rawal, a sun-browned Rajput with shoulder-length hair, saffron headband, off-white angarkha, rust-red battlevest and his own talwar, all in dark green, cream, deep red, rust red and brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two historical Indian rivals standing side by side: Mahmud Begada and Patai Rawal during the late 15th-century siege of Pavagadh. Mahmud is a broad-faced, wheatish-complexioned young sultan with a neatly trimmed black beard and calm, commanding eyes, wearing a tall dark-green conical turban wrapped with a cream band and a small central green jewel. His outfit is a long, dark-green quilted jama-style coat to mid-calf with subtle diamond padding, tied diagonally to the right with a cream sash, over a cream under-tunic and loose cream churidar trousers, with a hint of mail vest visible at the coat opening. He has a light cream shawl with thin dark-green border over his shoulders, a dark-brown leather belt, mid-calf dark-brown leather boots, small gold hoop earrings and a simple ring. At his belt hangs a slightly curved Indo-Persian talwar in a dark-brown leather scabbard with simple steel fittings. Beside him, Patai Rawal is a lean, sun-browned Rajput with a narrow face, proud defiant eyes, wavy shoulder-length black hair held back by a saffron-orange cloth headband with a small central metal disc, a strong moustache and short beard. He wears a knee-length off-white cotton angarkha wrapped to the left with a faint red border, bound by a deep-red cloth kamarband, reddish-brown fitted trousers, and a sleeveless rust-red battlevest over a short mail shirt visible at the arms. He has a narrow iron armguard on his left forearm, simple brown leather sandals, minimal jewellery (thin gold chain, small studs) and a red cotton tilak on his forehead. His Rajput-style steel talwar with brass hilt and red-brown leather scabbard rests at his left hip. Use a colour palette dominated by dark green, cream, deep red, rust red and warm brown, show them front-facing and clearly, with consistent facial features, hair, clothing details and weapons for reliable redraws in many panels.
